record.question: Which country is known as the land of 'white elephants'?
record.explanation: Answer B: Thailand. Thailand, formerly Siam, is the listed country traditionally called the land of white elephants. The historical published travel account Siam: The Land of the White Elephant documents the epithet directly; Thailand's Foreign Ministry confirms Siam is the former name. Historical/source note: Traditional historical nickname; white elephant does not mean all elephants in Thailand are white. Reference: https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/38078/pg38078-images.html; https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/content/82024-about-thailand?cate=5f2061a6821d3d0be144d02e. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
